method: For every question in the bank, its key + stem terms were BM25-scored against 90-second windows of each video's own YouTube caption track (153/153 videos, pulled 2026-09-06). The top candidates were judged from the caption text by a model reading it (31 batches by Claude Opus-class review agents, the remaining batches read inline by Claude in the same session); a candidate counts only if the caption text states the tested fact. Every accepted match carries a verbatim caption quote that was then located mechanically in the track (all exact); `at` is that position minus 3 s. A targeted second look struck 4 matches. Five videos were added from the channel after the first pass (bone healing, osteoporosis, aerobic ATP, glycolysis, scapula movers) and judged the same way. Captions are not shipped.
